en-US.description: A powerful and easy-to-use screenshot/sticker tool that helps you improve efficiency
en-US.name: PixPin (Beta)
en-US.publisher: Shenzhen Shendu Tujing Technology Co., Ltd.
en-US.releaseNotes:
Feature Changes
- [Screenshot] The shortcut key tooltip panel now supports showing or hiding with F1.
Improvements
- [Screenshot] Optimized the avoidance and movement effects of the shortcut key tooltip panel to reduce positional jitter.
- [Text Recognition] When entering text recognition from a screenshot with a watermark, the recognized image no longer includes the watermark.
- [Save] Removed the floating prompt after successful saving; when closing the save results page, the window now closes immediately upon completion of the save.
Bug Fixes
- [Sticker] Fixed an issue where pasting PNG images into WPS on Windows resulted in blank images.
- [Sticker] Fixed an issue where stickers did not receive keyboard focus after restoring the last closed sticker.
- [Sticker] Fixed an issue where some multi-line formulas within Markdown content failed to render correctly.
- [Sticker] Fixed a potential crash when destroying stickers in batches.
- [Annotation] Fixed incorrect HSV values in the color picker and abnormal transparency when changing colors.
- [Annotation] Fixed issues with text annotation box size and line breaks after adjusting the selection area.
- [Screenshot] Fixed a ghosting issue when dragging the bottom-right control point of a rounded-corner selection.
- [Long Screenshot] Fixed display and preview position anomalies under macOS with multiple monitors.
- [Screen Recording] Fixed the issue where the export progress window disappeared after triggering a screenshot during export.
- [Screen Recording] Fixed potential crashes in certain scenarios involving closing playback windows and handling abnormal videos.
Membership Features
- [Translation] When selecting the original text or translation, highlight the corresponding text in the image; this can be disabled in the translation settings.
- [Translation] Improved text recognition for Korean, Russian, Thai, Arabic, and other languages in image translation, reducing misrecognition.
- [Translation] Optimized reusing previously recognized source text when switching translation languages.
- [Translation, Formula Recognition, Table Recognition] When entering the recognition window from a screenshot, the recognized image no longer includes a watermark.
- [Translation, Document Recognition] Fixed an issue where pressing Esc failed to close the window.

zh-CN.description: 功能强大使用简单的截图/贴图工具，帮助你提高效率
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
功能变化
-【截图】快捷键提示面板支持按 F1 显示或隐藏
优化
-【截图】优化快捷键提示面板的避让和移动效果，减少位置跳动。
-【文字识别】从带水印的截图进入文字识别时，识别图像不再包含水印。
-【保存】取消保存成功后的浮动提示；关闭保存结果页时，保存完成后立即关闭窗口。
问题修复
-【贴图】修复 Windows 下 PNG 图片粘贴到 WPS 后显示空白的问题。
-【贴图】修复恢复上次关闭的贴图后，贴图未获得键盘焦点的问题。
-【贴图】修复 Markdown 内容中的部分多行公式无法正常渲染的问题。
-【贴图】修复批量销毁贴图时可能崩溃的问题。
-【标注】修复颜色选择器中 HSV 数值不正确，以及修改颜色时透明度异常的问题。
-【标注】修复调整选区后，文字标注的文本框大小和换行异常的问题。
-【截图】修复拖动圆角选区右下角控制点时出现拖影的问题。
-【长截图】修复 macOS 多屏幕下遮罩显示和预览位置异常的问题。
-【录屏】修复导出过程中触发截图后，导出进度窗口消失的问题。
-【录屏】修复部分回放窗口关闭和异常视频处理场景下可能崩溃的问题。
会员相关
-【翻译】选中原文或译文时，在对应图片中高亮显示相关文字，可在翻译设置中关闭。
-【翻译】改善韩语、俄语、泰语、阿拉伯语等语言在图片翻译中的文字识别，减少误识别。
-【翻译】优化切换翻译语言时对已识别原文的复用。
-【翻译、公式识别、表格识别】从截图进入识别窗口时，识别图像不再包含水印。
-【翻译、文档识别】修复按 Esc 无法关闭窗口的问题。
